displayIdentity.body: Jesus says Satan asked to sift the disciples, tells Peter he prayed that his faith not fail, charges him to strengthen brothers after turning, and predicts three denials.
displayIdentity.title: Satan’s demand, Jesus’ prayer, and Peter’s predicted turn
